_readme: 3.3.5a addons for the private server game version. Most 3.3.5a backports have no releases, so the 'Addon catalog 3.3.5a' workflow snapshots each repo's branch (the default one, or 'branch') and only keeps repos whose TOC says Interface 303xx. Sources mostly from github.com/NoM0Re/WoW-3.3.5a-Addons.
